protocol.grouping: 208 FPS anchors, each paired in FPS order with its two nearest unused nonanchor coordinates. Ties use original row order.
protocol.initial_basis: u=ones/sqrt3; dominant eigenvector of local3x3K restricted to mean-orthogonal plane gives contrast v; w=cross(u,v). Largest-magnitude entry of initial v has positive sign.
protocol.ordering: First208 mean columns, next208 contrasts, next208 fine columns, then untouched coordinates.
protocol.baseline: Fixed matrix-derived triplet basis from start; captures reconstructed x9/x10.
protocol.protected_basis: Every update preserves the exact original mean columns; changes only contrasts within mean-orthogonal planes.
protocol.zero_fallback: Retain original contrast if centered local candidate norm <=64eps*max(local candidate norm,tiny).
protocol.external_controls: Previously verified coordinate416 and fixed45pair upfront iteration counts, matched operator/data hashes; not native timing comparisons.
protocol.offline: Dense kernels, exact reference, rotations, pairing and rebuilds are free oracle work. No native runtime, memory, or transformed-entry cost claim.
protocol.stopping: Reuse repaired pair solver: full original reconstruction and b-Ax check every iteration, strict1e-8; no hidden repair.
